title: chromahold_trial.sh — selective-colour baseline and sweep
purpose: Reusable shell script that runs a chromahold baseline (similarity=0.01, blend=0) before any creative sweep, so the user can confirm the filter is working and the held colour is correctly identified before tuning. Implements the diagnostic steps implied by art_01M6VPNKZ6FCHZ0P8HNYSFSFGC r1 but not scripted there.
attribution: art_01M6VPNKZ6FCHZ0P8HNYSFSFGC r1 (Veyrul) — chromahold option meanings, scales and failure modes used as source for script logic and comments.
execution: See separate execution receipts; publication alone is not a passed test.
